concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 8 Social Science ke Chapter 9 — राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन का संगठन (1870–1947) — padhenge. Is chapter mein dekhenge ki British shasan ke baad logon mein dissatisfaction kaise badhi, राष्ट्रवाद ka idea kaise bana, Indian National Congress 1885 mein kaise bani, madyamargi aur aamool-parivartanvadi netritva mein kya fark tha, Bengal Partition aur Swadeshi Movement, Muslim League aur Lucknow Pact, aur First World War ke baad जनराष्ट्रवाद ke saath Mahatma Gandhi ka aana. Yeh sab NCERT ke isi hisse par aadharit hai — 1870s se lekar 1919 ke shuru tak.
concept_map.welcome: Namaste bacchon! Smart Board par aaj ek bahut zaroori History chapter shuru karte hain — राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन का संगठन. Socho: agar kisi desh ke log bolne lagen — 'Yeh desh humara hai, angrezon ka nahi' — toh yeh feeling kaise aayi? Aaj hum wahi story samjhenge — Poona Public Sabha se Congress, Tilak ke nare se Swadeshi, aur Gandhi ji ke aane tak. Ready ho? Chalo blackboard ki taraf!
learning_outcomes: राष्ट्रवाद ke uday ko samajhte hue batana ki 'भारत का मतलब यहाँ की जनता' idea kaise bana aur संप्रभुता kya hoti hai
Arms Act (1878), Vernacular Press Act (1878) aur Ilbert Bill (1883) se British shasan ke pratikriya aur Indian dissatisfaction explain karna
Indian National Congress (1885) ki sthapana, early leaders aur madyamargi maangen (Indianisation, Councils, Civil Service) yaad rakhna
Extremists (Pal–Tilak–Lajpat Rai), Bengal Partition 1905, Swadeshi, Muslim League 1906, Congress split 1907 aur Lucknow Pact 1916 ko sequence mein jodna
First World War ke aarthik-raajneetik asar aur Gandhi ji ke aane (South Africa, Champaran–Kheda–Ahmedabad) se जनराष्ट्रवाद ka uday samajhna

generated.concept: राष्ट्रवाद का उदय – भारत का मतलब और संप्रभुता
generated.say: Bacchon, pehle chapters mein hum padh chuke hain — angrezon ka kabu, naye kanoon, kisan-adivasi jeevan, shiksha, mahilaon ki sthiti, jati vyavastha ki chunautiyan, 1857 ka vidroh, aur udyogon ka vikas. Ab sawaal yeh hai: kya Bharat ke log British shasan se asantusht the? Agar haan, toh alag-alag groups kyun asantusht the? Inhi badlavon ne logon ko ek bada sawaal sochne par majboor kiya — Yeh desh kya hai aur kiske liye hai? Jawab dheere-dheere aaya: Bharat ka matlab hai yahan ki janta. Bharat yahan rehne wale kisi bhi varg, rang, jati, panth, bhasha ya gender wale tamam logon ka ghar hai. Yeh desh, uske saare resources aur saari vyavastha un sabke liye hai. Is jawab ke saath yeh ehsaas bhi aaya ki angrez Bharat ke resources aur logon ki zindagi par kabza jamaye hue hain — jab tak yeh control khatam nahi hota, Bharat yahan ke logon ka, Bharatiyon ka nahi ho sakta. Yeh chetna 1850 ke baad bane political organisations mein saaf dikhne lagi, aur 1870–1880 ke dashakon mein aur gehri ho gayi. Inmein se zyadatar organisations ki baagdor vakil aadi angrezi-shikshit professionals ke haath mein thi — Poona Public Sabha, Indian Association, Madras Mahajan Sabha, Bombay Residency Association, aur baad mein Indian National Congress. 'Poona Public Sabha' naam gaur se dekho — 'सार्वजनिक' matlab 'sab logon ka ya sabke liye' (sarva = sabhi, janik = logon ka). Bahut se organisations desh ke khas hisson mein kaam karte the, lekin apne lakshya ko Bharat ke sabhi logon ka lakshya batate the. Woh is soch ke saath kaam kar rahe the ki log सम्प्रभु hon. संप्रभुता ek modern vichar hai aur राष्ट्रवाद ka buniyadi tatva — matlab bahari hastakshep ke bina swatantra roop se kadam uthane ki kshamata. Yaad rakho chain: dissatisfaction → 'desh kiske liye?' → Bharat = janta → sovereignty → nationalism.

generated.concept: ब्रिटिश शासन के प्रति असंतोष – Arms Act, Vernacular Press Act और Ilbert Bill
generated.say: Ab dekho bacchon — 1870 aur 1880 ke dashakon mein British shasan ke prati asantosh aur zyada gehra hua. Teen important events yaad rakhne hain. Pehla: 1878 mein Arms Act pass hua — iske zariye Bharatiyon dwara apne paas hathiyar rakhne ka adhikar cheen liya gaya. Doosra: usi saal Vernacular Press Act bhi aaya, jisse sarkar ki aalochana karne walon ko chup karaya ja sake. Is kanoon mein pravadhan tha ki agar kisi akhbar mein koi 'aapattijanik' cheez chhapti hai, toh sarkar uski printing press sahit saari sampatti zabt kar sakti hai — matlab desi bhasha ke newspapers par tight control. Teesra: 1883 mein sarkar ne Ilbert Bill lagu karne ka prayas kiya. Is vidheyak mein pravadhan tha ki Bharatiya nyayadhish bhi British ya European vyaktiyon par mukadme chala sakte hain — taaki Bharat mein kaam karne wale angrez aur Bharatiya nyayadhishon ke beech samanta sthapit ki ja sake. Jab angrezon ke virodh ki wajah se sarkar ne yeh vidheyak wapas le liya, toh Bharatiyon ne is baat ka kafi virodh kiya. Is ghatna se Bharat mein angrezon ke asli ravaiye ka pata chalta tha — equality sirf paper par, asliyat mein nahi. Padhe-likhe Bharatiyon ke ek all-India organisation ki zarurat 1880 se hi mehsoos ki ja rahi thi, par Ilbert Bill ne is chah ko aur gehra kar diya. Classroom tip: in teenon events ko 'control–silence–double standard' se jodo — Arms Act = control over Indians' rights; Vernacular Press Act = silence criticism; Ilbert Bill withdrawal = racial double standard. Yahi asantosh baad mein Congress jaise national platform ki taraf le gaya.
generated.example: Agar school mein rule ho ki sirf kuch students hi complaint box use kar saken, aur equality wala naya rule teacher ke pressure se wapas le liya jaaye — toh baaki students ka gussa badhega; wahi Ilbert Bill wapas lene ka asar tha.

generated.say: Ab sabse important organisation — भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस. Padhe-likhe Bharatiyon ke ek akhil Bharatiya sangathan ki zarurat 1880 se mehsoos ho rahi thi; Ilbert Bill ne is chah ko aur gehra kiya. 1885 mein desh bhar ke 72 pratinidhiyon ne Bombay mein sabha karke Indian National Congress ki sthapana ka faisla liya. Organisation ke prarambhik neta — Dadabhai Naoroji, Pherozeshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, W.C. Bonnerji, Surendranath Banerjea, Romesh Chandra Dutt, S. Subramania Iyer aur anya — prayah Bombay aur Calcutta ke hi the. Naoroji vyavasayi aur pracharak the — pracharak matlab aisa vyakti jo suchnaon ke prasaar, reports, baithakon mein bhashan aadi ke zariye kisi khas vichar ka prachar-prasar karta hai. Woh London mein rehte the aur kuch samay ke liye British Parliament ke sadasya bhi rahe; unhone yuva rashtravadiyon ka margdarshan kiya. Unki pustak Poverty and Un-British Rule in India mein British shasan ke aarthik parinaamon ki bahut teekhi aalochana thi. Sevanivritt British officer A.O. Hume ne bhi vibhinn kshetron ke Bharatiyon ko nikat lane mein ahem bhumika ada ki. January 1886 mein The Indian Mirror newspaper ne likha — Bombay mein aayojit pratham National Congress hamare desh ki bhavi sansad ka kendrak hai. Badruddin Tyabji ne 1887 mein adhyaksh ki haisiyat se kaha — yeh Congress Bharat ke kisi ek varg ya samuday ke pratinidhiyon se milkar nahi bani, balki yeh Bharat ke sabhi samudayon ki sanstha hai. Shuruat se hi Congress sabhi Bharatiya logon ke hak mein aur unki ore se bolne ka sankalp vyakt kar rahi thi. Yaad rakho: 1885, Bombay, 72 delegates, early leaders mostly Bombay–Calcutta, Hume as connector, Naoroji as guide and economic critic.

generated.concept: उभरता हुआ राष्ट्र – मध्यमार्गी कांग्रेस की माँगें
generated.say: Aksar kaha jata hai ki apne pehle bees saalon mein Congress apne uddeshya aur tarikon ke lihaz se 'मध्यमार्गी' party thi. Is dauran Congress ne sarkar aur shasan mein Bharatiyon ko aur zyada jagah diye jane ke liye aawaz uthayi. Congress ka aagrah tha: Vidhan Parishadon mein Bharatiyon ko zyada jagah di jaaye, parishadon ko zyada adhikar diye jaayein, aur jahan parishaden nahi hain wahan unka gathan ho. Congress chahti thi ki sarkar mein Bharatiyon ko bhi oonche pad diye jaayein — iske liye maang ki Civil Service exam London ke saath-saath Bharat mein bhi aayojit ki jaaye. Shasan vyavastha ke Bharatiyakaran ki maang nasalvad ke khilaaf chal rahe andolan ka hissa thi, kyunki tab tak zyadatar mahattvapurn naukriyon par gore afsaron ka hi kabza tha. Angrez usually maante the ki Bharatiyon ko zimmedari bhare pad nahi diye ja sakte. Kyunki angrez afsar apne bhaari-bharkam vetan ka bada hissa Britain bhej dete the, isliye logon ko ummeed thi ki Bharatiyakaran se dhan-sampatti kuch had tak Bharat mein rukne lagegi. Bharatiyon ki maang thi: nyayapalika ko karyapalika se alag kiya jaaye, Arms Act ko निरस्त kiya jaaye, aur abhivyakti/bolne ki swatantrata di jaaye. Shuruati saalon mein Congress ne kai aarthik mudde bhi uthaye — uska kehna tha ki Bharat mein British shasan ki wajah se hi garibi aur akaal pad rahe hain. Badhte lagaan se kashtkar aur zamindar vipann hue, anaj ke bhaari niryat se khadya padarthon ka abhav paida hua. Congress ki maang: lagaan kam, fauji kharchon mein katoi, sinchai ke liye zyada anudan. Usne namak kar, videshon mein Bharatiya mazdooron ke saath bartav, aur van prashasan se vanvasiyon ki mushkilon par bhi prastav pass kiye — matlab padhe-likhe sampann varg ki sanstha hote hue bhi Congress sirf professionals, zamindaron aur udyogpatiyon ke hak mein hi nahi bol rahi thi. Madyamargi neta janta ko British shasan ke anyaypurn charitra se avagat karana chahte the — akhbar nikale, lekh likhe, bhashan diye, pratinidhi bheje. Lekin unhe yeh bhi lagta tha ki angrez swatantrata aur nyay ke aadarshon ka samman karte hain, isliye nyaysangat maangen sweekar kar lenge. Isliye Congress ka manna tha sarkar ko Bharatiyon ki bhavna se avagat karaya jana chahiye — yahi 'निवेदन की राजनीति' thi.

worked_example.problem: Early Congress ke teen political aur teen economic demands likho. Unka method kya tha?
steps: Political: zyada Indians in Councils; Councils ko zyada powers; Civil Service exam in India / Indianisation of high posts; judiciary-executive separation; Arms Act repeal; freedom of speech
Economic: reduce rent; cut military expenditure; more irrigation grants; also salt tax, indentured labour treatment, forest administration issues
Method: newspapers, articles, speeches, sending representatives — convince government (petition politics), belief that British respect justice
worked_example.answer: Political: Councils, Indianisation/Civil Service in India, rights/freedom; Economic: lower rent, cut army spend, irrigation; Method: petition/public opinion — not mass revolt yet.

generated.say: 1905 mein Viceroy Curzon ne Bengal ka vibhajan kar diya. Us waqt Bengal British Bharat ka sabse bada prant tha — Bihar aur Odisha ke kuch bhag bhi usmein the. Angrezon ka kehna tha ki prashasaniya suvidha ke liye batwara zaroori tha. Par sawaal yeh hai — is 'suvidha' ka matlab kya? Kisko suvidha milne wali thi? Zahir hai iska talluk angrez afsaron aur vyapariyon ke fayde se tha. Sarkar ne gair-Bangali ilakon ko alag karne ki bajay uske poorvi bhagon ko alag karke Assam mein mila diya. Poorvi Bengal ko alag karne ke peeche angrezon ka mukhya uddeshya yeh raha hoga ki Bangali rajnetaon ke prabhav par ankush lagaya jaaye aur Bangali janta ko baant diya jaaye. Vibhajan se desh bhar mein gusse ki lahar fail gayi. Madyamargi aur aamool-parivartanvadi — Congress ke sabhi dhadon ne virodh kiya. Vishal jansabhaayein, juloos, aur jan-pratirodh ke naye raste dhoondhe gaye. Is sangharsh ko स्वदेशी आंदोलन ke naam se jana jata hai. Yeh andolan Bengal mein sabse takatvar tha, lekin anya ilakon mein bhi uski anugoonj sunayi di — Andhra ke delta ilakon mein ise Vande Mataram andolan ke naam se jana jata tha. Swadeshi andolan ne British shasan ka virodh kiya aur स्वयं सहायता, स्वदेशी उद्यमों, राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा aur Bharatiya bhasha ke upyog ko badhava diya. स्वराज ke liye aamool-parivartanvadi ne janta ko lamband karne aur British sansthanon v vastuyon ke बहिष्कार par zor diya. Kuch log British shasan ko ukhaad phenkne ke liye 'क्रांतिकारी हिंसा' ke samarthak the — yani samaj mein aamool badlav ke liye hinsa ka upyog. Board pe yaad rakho: Partition 1905 (Curzon) → anger → Swadeshi (self-help, swadeshi enterprise, national education, Indian languages, boycott) → strongest in Bengal, echo elsewhere as Vande Mataram movement in Andhra deltas.

League ki maang thi ki Musalmanon ke liye alag निर्वाचिका (separate electorate) ki vyavastha ki jaaye. 1909 mein sarkar ne yeh maang maan li — ab parishadon mein kuch seats Muslim umeedwaron ke liye aarakshit kar di gayin jinhen Muslim matdataon dwara hi chunkar bheja jana tha. Kisan, adivasi, vidyarthi aur mahilaayein badi sankhya mein judte gaye; kai baar audyogik mazdooron ne bhi yogdan diya. Bees ke dashak se kuch khas vyavasayik samooh bhi Congress ko sakriya samarthan dene lage. Kyun? Pehle Vishwa Yuddha ne Bharat ki aarthik aur rajneetik sthiti badal di. Yuddha ki wajah se British Bharat sarkar ke raksha vyay mein bhaari izafa hua; is kharche ke liye sarkar ne niji aay aur vyavasayik munafa par tax badha diya. Sainik vyay aur yuddhak aapurti ki wajah se zaruri cheezon ke daam bhaari uchaal par aa gaye — aam logon ki zindagi mushkil. Doosri ore vyavasayik samooh yuddha se behisaab munafa kama rahe the; industrial vastuon (jute ke bore, kapde, patriyan) ki maang badhi, imports kam hue — isliye Bharatiya udyogon ka vistaar hua aur business groups aur maukon ki maang karne lage. Yuddha ne angrezon ko sena badhane par majboor kiya; gaon mein sipahiyon ki bharti ke liye dabav dala gaya; bahut se sipahi videshi morchon par gaye aur lautkar samjhe ki samrajyavadi shaktiyan Asia–Africa ke logon ka kaise shoshan karti hain — yeh log bhi colonial shasan ka virodh karne lage. 1917 mein Russia mein kranti hui; kisan-mazdoor sangharshon aur socialist vicharon ke samachar failne lage, jisse Bharatiya rashtravadiyon ko nayi prerana mili. Inhi haalat mein Mahatma Gandhi ek jan-neta ke roop mein saamne aaye. Gandhi ji 46 varsh ki umra mein 1915 mein South Africa se Bharat laute — wahan nasali paabandiyon ke khilaaf ahimsak andolan chala rahe the, antarrashtriya star par manyata aur aadar mil chuka tha. South Africa movements ki wajah se unhein Hindu, Muslim, Parsi, Christian; Gujarati, Tamil, Uttar Bharatiya; uchch-vargiya vyapari, vakil aur mazdoor — sab tarah ke Bharatiyon se milne-julne ka mauka mil chuka tha. 1895 mein anya Bharatiyon ke saath unhone Natal Congress banayi thi. Bharat aane ke pehle saal unhone poora Bharat daura kiya — logon, zaruraton aur haalat ko samajhne ke liye. Shuruati prayas Champaran, Kheda aur Ahmedabad ke sthaniya andolanon ke roop mein aaye; inse Rajendra Prasad aur Vallabhbhai Patel se parichay hua. 1918 mein Ahmedabad mein unhone mill mazdooron ki hartal ka safaltapoorvak netritva kiya. Phir 1919 se Rowlatt Satyagraha ka daur shuru hota hai — jise aage chapters/sections mein detail mein dekha jata hai. Yaad rakho: World War → prices/taxes + industry boom + returned soldiers + Russian Revolution inspiration → mass nationalism → Gandhi as mass leader after local struggles.
